findings.description: DEFECT: the required boot-server → machines response route survives, but its entire boot.ipxe + S3 args payload label is skipped. This is not 23/23 readable semantic coverage; the reciprocal iPXE request alone does not preserve the response meaning.

DEFECT: source-described fastest heartbeat and slow ops path qualifiers are absent from all four views. The generator explicitly lists both as deliberate drops. Constant shared animation speed is legal and is NOT a failure for lacking differentiated timing; the missing source text/qualifier coverage is the defect. A ledger outside the drawing does not preserve a required qualifier on the view.

DEFECT: audit reimage retains audit/reimage but omits the verify action in the source audit / verify reimage relation. No on-view key expands this as verification. Treat this as lost label meaning, not a missing/reversed geometric edge.

DEFECT and check/capture contradiction: all 23 frame-0 dots are one drawn cell beyond the first external cell after the node-border source port. Actual origin passes are 0/23, versus check claims 7/7,7/7,5/5,4/4. Under the explicit rubric this leaves the animated arrows directionally unproven even though their static stems/heads can be traced. Exact required/actual coordinates are in every edge audit and the immutable blind table.

DEFECT: five label-owner problems localized blind: reinstall/reprov (v1), provider API and cluster state (v2), diag uploads and runs on host (v3). All four checks report 1/2/2/1 ambiguous owners; the sixth, in v4, is unlocalized, so do not invent its identity. No demonstrated impossibility of unambiguous placement is recorded; reporting warnings alone does not qualify for the exception. Nearby bends stay separate; there are no actual crossings or fake branch arrows.

DEFECT: v1 clips the initial m of machine rows at 77×47; the visible text is achine rows at column 1. The natural 75×32 extent and the full 83×51 live label do not rescue this target-size clipping. All node boxes and routes otherwise fit without palette occlusion.

DEFECT: dots occupy non-origin corners on e22 at [49,20] (frames 0/1) and e18 at [49,16] (frames 0/1 and each six-frame cycle). The true origins are [49,19] and [49,15], so the origin-corner exception does not apply. No bridge, junction, border, or label dot occupancy was observed.

DEFECT: generator-disclosed short stems e8 and e10 repeat a two-position loop rather than traversing the arrow: e8 [15,36] ↔ [15,37], head [15,38]; e10 [19,16] ↔ [19,17], head [19,18]. Both loops are independently visible. Checks report one dot violation in v2 and one in v3 but do not identify edges/reasons, so generator attribution is not a counter-to-edge proof. Several other short routes have analogous loops. This is incomplete through-route motion, NOT unequal arrival timing and NOT an imposed same-arrival requirement.

DEFECT: the same eligible-cell cadence is not constant speed over drawn route cells. Before any wrap, v1 e1 advances one drawn cell from [13,16] to [13,17] between frames 0 and 2, but e3 advances two drawn cells from [15,24] through its corner to [16,25]. All routes use the legal default mode, but corner skipping makes the observed physical advances unequal. Long routes finishing later is legal and is not scored as a defect.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER, not a demonstrated broken border: live 83×51 ANSI/select-all proves complete color-continuous regular and selected perimeters for 25/25 node occurrences. Pinned 77×47 evidence is frames-only plain text: target selected-border/color coverage is 0/25. Geometry alone cannot establish target-state color or selected palette clearance; border_integrity is blocked, not pass.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER: exact executed argv for checks/captures/probes, per-rejected-check exit status/full stdout-vs-stderr attribution, and verbatim pane-close results are not preserved. Final manifests record check_exit=0 and confirmed_closed for four panes; two manual probe panes have only narrative close declarations. Live frame dumps are 1000-line tails, not complete live laps. Seven flagged reconstructed drafts are not original executed spec bytes. Target-size long probes do preserve complete cycles and match final pinned prefixes, so do not falsely call target motion evidence missing.

PROTOCOL DEFECT / inconsistent attempt accounting: 17 attempt entries (3/5/3/6) exceed the recorded 3-per-view budget for v2/v4. The nine hard-refusals claim is contradicted by only five raw refusal checks (v4 a1–a5); other raw checks succeeded but overflowed or had warnings. The narrative says six reconstructed drafts, while seven entries are flagged reconstructed. These are disclosed procedural/evidence inconsistencies, not grounds to invent extra visual requirements; workflow already fails on missing reproducible raw execution records.

blockers: Target selected/color-state evidence is unavailable: pinned 77×47 dumps are plain-text frames only (0/25 target selected borders); larger live select-all coverage is 25/25. This blocks border_integrity, not the already demonstrated failures.

Exact executed argv, raw per-rejected-check exit statuses and verbatim close outcomes are missing. Four evidence panes have manifest confirmed_closed records; two manual probes have narrative declarations only. No new live verification was performed.

Frozen renderer refused five attempted combined ops/reconcile layouts (v4 a1–a5) at both orientations. Final four-view split works around endpoint coverage, so those refusals do not prove the case globally impossible. Skipped response label and motion-origin/corner behavior remain concrete renderer failures requiring correction or a declared supported subset, not excuses to pass.

The sixth reported owner ambiguity (v4) has no label identity in the check output and was not independently localized; five are localized. Do not infer that sixth identity or grant an impossibility exception.
